Plan · DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Free OpenCode

conclusion: The two-key inline overlay initializes the requested model and agent only when no higher-priority native agent/model or policy source conflicts. It does not initialize the selected max variant.
existing_content: A valid JSON-object existing OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT was shallow-copied with Python insertion-order dictionaries, replacing only model/default_agent; every other raw field and its key order were preserved, and nested/array native configuration remained effective. This does not qualify arbitrary map decode/remarshal: native preserves property order and permission precedence can depend on it. General JSONC/templates and other native configuration origins are not live-qualified here; existing content must remain gated without a qualified preservation method.
profile_preservation: Schema-present profile configuration stayed byte-for-byte unchanged. Native itself auto-adds $schema to schema-less path-backed config, observed in retained initial attempts.
variant: No Max displayed; config/provider option defaults and true TUI selected variant are distinct. See bootstrap-source-proof.json for source-only limits.
agent_conflict: The conflicting profile would require changing the effective plan-agent model (or a real per-client selection setter, absent from the pinned public API). Such an override changes plan-agent semantics across this native server, including relevant child calls; it was not applied. The two-key global overlay is also a server-scoped default, not a session-only binding.
scope: Private wrapper through installed Swarm isolated daemon; not production managed-adapter path. No prompt sent, no fake history seed, no owner profile or production daemon changed.
cleanup: All probe TUI sessions and owned native servers stopped, credential files retired, native histories retained.
